versions.period_use: The official consolidated form text confirms 01/GTGT in TT80 Appendix II. TT40/2025 address-field changes and the full official TT94/2025 text were reviewed. TT94 changes VAT-refund administration provisions and identity-document wording/fields on templates that contain those fields; 01/GTGT contains no individual identity-document field, so the review found no 01/GTGT field or formula change. TT21/2026 status for 01/GTGT remains subject to the reviewed form inventory. Filing-period transition and taxpayer case still require human review; no automatic selection.

94/2025/TT-BTC full text was reviewed in the official Gazette signed attachment (pp. 40–42): Article 1 changes VAT refund administration and adds personal-identity wording/fields to specified templates; Article 2 changes templates under TT40/2021. The review found no 01/GTGT field or formula change because that organizational return has no individual identity-document field.
21/2026/TT-BTC expressly replaces 02/TNDN and 05/TNDN forms; its replacement list does not include 01/GTGT.
